text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Yukino Bijin and I are on
the way
home after doing some
shopping...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowie! Lookie here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy now! The raffle is a whole
lotta fun!
Everyone's welcome to give it
a try!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wow, they're giv'n away a hot spring
vacation?
That sounds great! I love hot
springs!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wish I could give the raffle a spin...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That reminds me... I'm sure we got a
raffle ticket
earlier with our purchases.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'mean it?! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll give't a go! Wish me luck!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin gives the raffle machine a
powerful
spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-holy smokes!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! I-I did it! I won us a
fancy-schmancy
hot spring vacation!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Cheese and crackers, that sure was
thrill'n! I've
got goosebumps all over!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I've never won a grand prize b'fore!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I almost want you t'pinch me to make
sure I'm not
dream'n!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
W-wow... In all my years running this
raffle, I've
never seen anyone get so
excited.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I mean, who wouldn't be jump'n for joy? It's the grand prize! It's the grandest of all grand prizes! A hot spring vacation!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I can hardly wait...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right, I have t'put this somewhere safe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No way, José! Now's an incred'bly
important time
for me, so I gotta keep
focused.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna hold on to this and save it as a
future
treat. That way, I'll be able t'relax
properly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'll be able t'work harder knowing
it's wait'n
for me!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Wow! What admirable self-restraint!
That's a
great goal too! I'll be cheerin'
for ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-oh! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hmmm. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, yes, there's that...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm also super happy t'have someone
cheer'n
me on! No matter how many
people tell me that,
it's still music t'my
ears!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Good idea! That way when we fin'lly go
on our
hot spring vacay, I can really kick
back and relax!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We'll have t'make sure you get your fair
share of
rest and relaxation in too,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! I-I didn't mean t'assume you'd
wanna...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Oh my goodness gracious! I-I'm so

embarrassed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm so used to us being t'gether that I
figured we'd
go on vacation t'gether too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, someone dig me a hole so I can
throw m'self
in!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-thank you for accept'n my
roundabout invite...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we agree to save the coupon
as a
reward for her hard work in the
future.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wowie! That looks absolutely
scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Back home, I only got t'eat hamburger
steaks on
special occasions!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's a famous hamburger steak
rest'rant I used
t'go to lots with my
family.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I always had fun there 'cause they had
loads of
diff'rent toppings you could
choose from, like
pineapple and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The first time we took my li'l sister there
when she
got old enough t'go out t'eat, I
picked out a
bunch of toppings for her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel all warm and fuzzy see'n
her so
happy eat'n the food I chose for
her!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, the two of us return to the
academy
and chat cheerfully over our
customized
hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers! We got a whole crop!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Will you be able to carry them all?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You betcha! Just leave it t'me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin lifts up the stack of boxes
and carries
them off like it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whew! We made it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw, shucks. This is noth'n compared to
carry'n
farming equipment.

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
I watched you walk aaall the way here
with those
carrots! You're sooo strong!

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how'dya get so strong anyway?!
Please tell
me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Umm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: By eat'n lots of carrots, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ewww! Carrots are yucky! But... if eating
them'll
make me strong...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, can I have one of yours? ...I'll try
and eat it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure! Give it a go!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Just one, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know what t'do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Could I ask a favor, please?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm so glad the clerk agreed
t'bake it for us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's also super-duper yummy! Try some,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nom.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How is it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it just? Someone back home taught
me how
t'eat 'em like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And now you know too! Everything's
com'n up
roses!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Just a pack of tissues, huh?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. You were so excited about
winning the
hot springs coupon too...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! There's no need t'apologize!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yukino, you blockhead! What're you
doing mak'n
other people feel bad for
you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin seems more upset about
making the
raffle clerk feel bad than
missing out on the hot
spring vacation.
